reviews.text: We are very happy with the help we have received so far from Ulla with our Australian shepherd. She has given us clear advice and activities that we can use in everyday life. We experience Ulla as clear and with a lot of experience. She is also easily available for questions that arise when we train our dog.

Ulla took the time to get to know us and what we needed help with. We then received a detailed and comprehensive description of what we were going to work on. In addition, she doesn't let go of our hand when she walks out the door, but will be available for further follow-up in the coming weeks. She was warm and clear towards both two-legged and four-legged people and we can really recommend her to others who need a little help with their little four-legged friend.
Very educational. Mostly for the owner, and then transfer it to the dog

Ulla is fantastic.
We had a very good and safe dialogue, and she is incredibly skilled at seeing both me and my dog. She gave us precise feedback and concrete advice that we can work on. I experienced her as professional, warm and clear, and she created an atmosphere where both me and my dog ​​could relax. Highly recommended.

Ulla is a very skilled and experienced dog trainer who creates a safe and good framework around her courses. She is good at adapting training and methods to each individual and their needs, and at the same time the group as a whole. Ulla has a clear, positive and good communication with both owners and dogs. She is concerned with relationships based on security and trust. Ulla is also concerned with staying professionally updated, and it is clear that she is passionate about her profession! Recommended!
I am very happy with Ulla🙌 She has the ability to see both dog and handler. We will be back several times 🤩 …

My hunting lab and I were on the course from chaos to contact with Ulla. This course was competition-oriented where we learned exercises for focus and contact on the field and between exercises. We got great tips for training, both details that can be refined in the exercises and how to work with the dog in transport. Ulla was both nice and gave us concrete advice and tips that we will take with us further 🐕🙂

Thank you for the educational course "From chaos to contact" with the talented Ulla Henriksen.
We have received many good tips and advice, which we will continue to practice and use at the entrance and on the field.

Great course, very nice training for anyone who is going to start LP or other branches with a lot of training on focus with distractions and entry on the track working between exercises. Very good training. Clear feedback from Ulla.

I have been on several courses with Ulla. She has a combination of high professionalism, enormous experience, pedagogical skills and a likeable northern Norwegian disposition, which together create a very inspiring and motivating atmosphere. She is able to see and encourage each individual horse in an adapted and caring way. Highly recommended!
Highly recommend Ulla! Ulla is knowledgeable, passionate about dog training, and we got the impression that she really cares about dogs and owners during the course. 10/10.

We can highly recommend Ulla as a dog trainer – especially for those of you with a shepherd dog. We have a Miniature American Shepherd (MAS) who went through a somewhat challenging period this winter, with a lot of stress in the garden and difficulties with passing other dogs. We had taken regular dog courses and received a lot of good help there, but still experienced that there were some breed-specific challenges that were not fully captured.

This is where Ulla really made a difference. Her special expertise in shepherd dogs meant that she quickly understood both the dog's needs and behavior. She gave us specific, targeted exercises and explained why these worked for a MAS – which gave us both a better understanding and far better results.
After the follow-up with Ulla, we have a much calmer and safer dog. The crossings have become much better, and the stress level in everyday life has been significantly reduced. We now feel that we have the tools we need to meet the dog's needs in a good way.

Thank you very much, Ulla – we are incredibly grateful for the help we have received!
Incredibly happy with the class and everything we learned from Ulla! Highly recommended!
Skilled dog trainer! Recommended!

Fantastic and knowledgeable trainer. She takes good care of everyone at puppy classes. She gives good and constructive feedback, and is very familiar with the different breeds on the course. Incredibly grateful to have Ulla as our first dog trainer, and hope we have her again in future courses.

Ulla, both a dog trainer and a person, taught us a lot about how we as dog owners can create "our perfect" life with a dog with the right training, focus and patience.
Over 6 weeks we were trained in various methods to solve both simple and difficult behaviors in our puppy. She gave good and specific tips and advice, both by telling her own experiences and by showing with our puppy, which we experience has helped us in everyday life.
Really recommend Ulla if you are looking for a skilled dog trainer with a fantastic commitment!

Highly recommended! Ulla is motivating, confident and knowledgeable, and always comes with good and helpful tips, tricks and experiences. Always available to answer questions, even outside of courses. You can tell that Ulla really cares about the dog and owner being successful with training and dog ownership. All in all, an extremely skilled dog trainer.
Great! Very nice and professional. I'm sorry we only made it to the first three sessions! Will be back - then agility!
We took the basic course with our 2.5 year old Lagotto. She was attentive to all the dogs and the needs of each dog. Kind and skilled dog trainer

We have a dog (7 years old, female) who has been quite insecure and has had aggressive behavior, and it has been quite demanding at times. We contacted Hund i Sentrum and were advised to take a basic course with dog trainer Ulla, and it has been absolutely fantastic! She really understands the dog's language and sees things we had never noticed ourselves. With her advice and guidance, we have already achieved an incredible amount in a short time. Even though we still have a long way to go until everything is in place, she has helped us so much to stand on our feet!! Highly recommended! 11/10.

We received fantastic help for our dog who had major challenges in the city! Ulla has made a huge effort and provided excellent follow-up for us all the way. Highly recommend Ulla if you need help with your dog!!!

Both owner and dog are very happy Ulla came to visit the house. She knows what she is doing. Clear, concrete, knowledgeable, safe, patient. Very professional and very nice! We recommend Ulla to others who need a personal dog trainer. Greetings Bruce (9 months old very reactive French Bulldog) and Hege (54 years old quite tired puppy mother, but now full of new courage).

In just two hours, Ulla helped us understand our dog’s needs and showed us how to guide her through the day with less stress. Truly wonderful support all around, you can completely trust Ulla with your dog and rely on her expert guidance.

Ulla is clear, knowledgeable and has a good balance in her philosophy. The dogs she trains should be built through a balance between positivity, fame, mastery and clear boundaries and expectations. This is easy for both dog and owner to relate to. She is good at understanding the language of dogs and has an excellent ability to communicate with both dog and owner.

We received very good help from Ulla! She took the time to look at the cooperation between us and our dog for almost 2 years. We are very positive about the methods we have received and the information we have received can give very good results! Highly recommended
Good communication, clear and skilled lady Ulla. We got help with exactly what we needed and felt well taken care of from the first phone call. Recommended!

Had a positive meeting with Ulla today. Professional and clear love for dogs. Got lots of concrete advice and tools to follow up on my dog. It was fun to see how Ulla communicates with the dog, and that there is hope for being able to succeed with something I have seen as hopeless.
Highly recommend Ulla
A wonderfully skilled and wonderful dog trainer who really knows dogs! We have taken both dog classes and private lessons with Ulla, and we will continue to do so! Highly recommended!

From having a dog that acted out on other dogs, I now have a much calmer dog in passages. After a home visit and a "bullying course" we are soon at our goal. Ulla is clear and concrete in her teaching and feedback, which I greatly appreciate. Highly recommended
Competent, calm, clear and patient. We are very satisfied!
Very happy after dog training with Ulla :)

Very happy that we got to take a course with Ulla! The call-in course was our start and then we joined the next one as well. Ulla has a lot of knowledge about dogs that she shares generously. She is dedicated, clear, funny, inspiring and no-bullshit!

Ulla is a patient and skilled dog trainer. She is also very nice and has a good sense of humor, which makes the training sessions both educational and fun. We received many good and concrete tips that have helped us a lot with our corgi. Highly recommended!

We had great pleasure and benefit from private lessons with Ulla. She is knowledgeable and calm, yet firm in a pleasant and motivating way. She gave us useful, simple tools and advice for everyday obedience with our 9 month old puppy.

Ulla is an incredibly knowledgeable and pleasant dog trainer, who offers many tips, advice and measures that help us dog owners become better "parents" for our four-legged family members💕
She teaches us to understand how the dog thinks, respect it and gives us all a sense of mastery!🐾
Ulla was knowledgeable, pleasant to work with and gave us great tips and tricks. Very satisfied 😊 …

We have had the pleasure of having Ulla as a dog trainer both in private lessons and on basic courses, and we couldn't be more satisfied! We have learned an incredible amount from her, both as owners and together with our dog.

What impresses us most is how Ulla really sees both us and the dog – even when we are on a course with many other participants. She adapts the level to exactly where we are, and gives specific and personal advice that suits our situation. This means that we experience mastery and progress after every single course session.

Getting to train around other dogs has been invaluable for the contact between us and the dog, and has given us many nice mastery experiences. We always leave the course with a good feeling and lots of motivation to move on!

Highly recommended to anyone who wants safe, clear and customized dog training!
Very good course. Got good help and guidance. Recommend basic course to everyone 😊 …
Clear, funny and serious dog trainer. Highly recommended!👍🏻 …
Very knowledgeable and good with many types of dogs. Been on a course with Ulla and she is good at seeing and helping everyone. Good focus on calm and good bonding with the dog. Highly recommended!
Ulla is knowledgeable, warm and clear ☺️ We had her for private lessons, and I am very, very happy to have received manageable tasks that will eventually make life with a dog easier 😊 …

Had a very positive experience with this dog trainer. She was incredibly knowledgeable and even had a good knowledge of my breed (Xoloitzcuintli). She quickly saw what the problem was with my dog ​​and gave me clear, concrete advice and guidance. The training, both indoors and outdoors, was very well structured, and I felt safe throughout the entire process. Got a lot of useful tips that I am already seeing results from! Can really recommend her to anyone who needs help with dog training.

We have both attended courses and had private lessons with Ulla where she came to our home. Skilled, clear and experienced lady who explains and guides in an understandable way. Ulla cares about the animal's best interests, and did not …
Ulla has very good knowledge of dogs!
Great dog trainer, highly recommended😃 …
